source:
defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def some_fun do
    some_val
    |> case do
      :this -> :that
      :that -> :this
    end

    some_val
    |> unless do
      :this
    end

    some_val
    |> if do
      :this
    else
      :that
    end

    some_val
    |> try do
      raise "oops"
    rescue
      e in RuntimeError -> e
    end
  end
end
